response.justification: While Bogdan is a capable and accomplished software engineer with strong fundamentals and mentoring inclination, he does not meet the role's minimum qualifications. Most critically, he has only 6 months of professional C++ experience versus the required 8 years—a fundamental technical requirement. Additionally, there is no evidence of formal technical leadership or mentoring experience with cloud/DevOps engineers. His career has focused on application and web services development rather than the deep infrastructure and distributed systems architecture expertise central to leading a cloud compute platform.
strengths: Proven track record as senior engineer across multiple roles demonstrating strong coding fundamentals and software craftsmanship principles including TDD and CI/CD
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and deployment technologies including AWS CDK, Kubernetes, and microservices handling high-traffic systems
Demonstrated commitment to knowledge sharing through workshops, teaching, and building frameworks to support developer growth and technical excellence
concerns: Critical gap in C++ expertise—only 6 months of professional experience at National Instruments versus the required 8 years minimum qualification
No evidence of formal technical leadership role or experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers despite capable engineering background
Career trajectory emphasizes application and web services development rather than infrastructure, distributed systems, and compute platform architecture required for this role
